definitions.explanation: A liquid dish, especially a Japanese-style soup such as miso soup.
The liquid extracted from fruits, vegetables, meat, or other ingredients.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味噌|みそ}{汁|しる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
{朝|あさ}ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧⟦{汁物|しるもの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しい→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: It's nice to have warm soup with breakfast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{汁|しる}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しかった→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Lots of juice came out of the meat, and it was very delicious.

notes:
{汁|しる} refers to liquid food (soup/broth) or the juice/sap from ingredients.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{味噌|みそ}{汁|しる}→味噌汁：04954_misoshiru⟧: miso soup
- ⟦{汁物|しるもの}→汁物：06231_shirumono⟧: soup dish (general term for Japanese soups)
- ⟦{果|か}{汁|じゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧: fruit juice (read as かじゅう)
- ⟦レモン{汁|じる}→レモン汁：23041_remonjiru⟧: lemon juice

Note: The reading changes in some compounds: {汁|しる} in standalone and native compounds, {汁|じる} in some food terms like ⟦レモン{汁|じる}→レモン汁：23041_remonjiru⟧, and {汁|じゅう} in Sino-Japanese compounds like ⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧.
